text:
Dependable week or not, we thank you for your message and we are sorry to hear that your pet travel experience with Aurelia Skyways did not match what was promised when the trip was booked. You described a missed connection, the stress this caused for you and your animal, and the feeling that the travel support around the handoff was not handled with enough care.

We review these events as safety issues first, because a missed handoff can raise stress for both the traveler and the animal. The right response is calm, steady, and practical. When a connection is disrupted, staff must keep the pet in a secure setting, limit handling, and make sure the traveler receives clear updates before the next step is taken. If a boarding plan or kennel plan has to change, the new plan should match the species, temperament, and comfort needs already noted for the animal.

I can confirm that your report has been sent for review by the Companion Animal Travel Desk, along with the transfer record and the notes from the ground team. <<FACT F110>> In parallel, we are checking whether the travel coordinator gave the expected guidance before departure and whether the escort process was followed in the correct order. If any part of the handling fell short, we will address it with the team involved and use it to strengthen future travel support.

Please keep any receipts, written notices, and trip documents together, since those items help us close the review accurately. If you have not already shared the pet's condition after arrival, that follow-up is also useful, especially if there were signs of stress, dehydration, or refusal to settle. We want the next trip to be smoother, safer, and easier to manage.

Aurelia Skyways takes companion animal travel seriously, and we will continue to handle your case with care until the review is complete.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
